# ထက် (Htet) — Official Portal & Academic Archive

> စာရေးဆရာမနှင့် နိုင်ငံရေးဒဿနိကဗေဒ သုတေသီ ထက် (Htet) ၏ တရားဝင် ဒစ်ဂျစ်တယ် မော်ကွန်းတိုက်နှင့် သုတေသန ပလက်ဖောင်း။ (Writer and political philosophy researcher specializing in Burmese political thought, intersectional feminism, democratic resistance, and gender justice).

## Core Pages & Archives

- [Home / မူလစာမျက်နှာ](https://htetofficial.github.io/index.html): Official digital portal, research highlights, and featured monographs.
- [Articles & Essays / စာတမ်းနှင့် ဆောင်းပါးများ](https://htetofficial.github.io/articles.html): Curated political philosophy essays, feminist theory, and resistance studies.
- [Publications & Books / စာအုပ်နှင့် စာတမ်းစာရင်း](https://htetofficial.github.io/publications.html): Published academic monographs, research papers, and open-access books.
- [Glossary of Concepts / သဘောတရားအဘိဓာန်](https://htetofficial.github.io/glossary.html): Theoretical lexicon on intersectionality, autonomy, and political philosophy.
- [Journal Feed / ဂျာနယ် မှတ်စုများ](https://htetofficial.github.io/journal.html): Continuous academic reflections, field notes, and democratic commentary.
- [Dictionary & BurmeseNLP / အဘိဓာန်](https://htetofficial.github.io/dictionary.html): Dual-direction Ornagai dictionary, 12,000+ parallel corpus, and NLP tools.
- [Translation Studio / ဘာသာပြန်](https://htetofficial.github.io/translate.html): Multi-engine translation and lexical synthesis studio.
- [About & Curriculum Vitae / ကိုယ်ရေးမှတ်တမ်း](https://htetofficial.github.io/about.html): Biography, curriculum vitae, and verified academic dossier.
- [Technology Stack & Engineering Colophon / နည်းပညာနှင့် ဖန်တီးသူများ](https://htetofficial.github.io/technology.html): Edge architecture, Burmese NLP engines, offline PWA, security standards, and contributor credits.
- [Contact & Channels / ဆက်သွယ်ရန်](https://htetofficial.github.io/contact.html): Official communication channels, Telegram networks, and PGP keys.
